metadata.cohort_selection: 100 cancer-related recruiting studies selected deterministically by NCT ID from title/condition matches; expanded from the 3,145-study Massachusetts recruiting snapshot acquired 2026-10-24
metadata.source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 individual study records
metadata.deduplication_key: facility_source_id within NCT when available; otherwise normalized NCT/facility/city/state/postal/country/coordinate tuple
limitations: The export covers only studies with expanded individual records in the local snapshot, not all recruiting Massachusetts studies.
Only locations explicitly labeled Massachusetts and site status RECRUITING are included.
coordinate_status verified means the source supplied a valid coordinate pair; TrialMatch did not independently geocode or confirm facility-level precision.
Facilities without a source coordinate pair are preserved as unresolved with null coordinates.
Records without a facility name cannot satisfy the geographic handoff schema and are counted as exclusions.
